description: Send a test webhook for a monitor using a simulated rate change. This actually delivers an HTTP request to the monitor's configured webhook URL. IMPORTANT: a test delivery is NOT signed with the monitor's signing secret — only a hash of that secret is stored, so test deliveries use a placeholder and will FAIL signature verification. Use this to test payload handling, not signature verification. Only use when the user explicitly requests a test webhook delivery.

monitor_id.description: The unique identifier of the monitor to test. Required.

rate_change.description: The simulated rate change event. Required.

product_type.description: The product type that changed (e.g., "30yr_fixed"). Required.

state.description: US state code where the rate changed. Required.

name: deliver_test_webhook

outputSchema.description: Result of firing a real test webhook at the monitor's stored URL, overriding the cooldown. On a missing id the tool returns a not-found shape instead of throwing.

error.description: Present and set to 'not_found' when the monitor id does not exist.

evaluation.description: Why the monitor did or did not fire.

conditions_met.description: Whether the trigger conditions were satisfied.

rate_change.description: The simulated change, with rates pre-formatted as percent strings.

change_pct.description: Signed change as a percent string.

new_rate.description: New rate as a percent string.

previous_rate.description: Prior rate as a percent string.

summary.description: Whether the test webhook was delivered and whether the monitor would have triggered, or a not-found message.

webhook_delivery.description: Outcome of the HTTP POST to the monitor's webhook URL. Omitted when the backend reported no delivery attempt.

delivered.description: True when the endpoint accepted the payload.

error.description: Failure reason when delivery did not succeed.

status_code.description: HTTP status returned by the endpoint.

would_trigger.description: Whether the monitor's conditions were satisfied by the supplied change.
